Class RTools

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.rbridge.RTools
public class RTools extends Object
This class provides methods for the communication with the R application.

    • evaluateExt

      public static void evaluateExt(String expression)
      Evaluates an R expression without running in a job. This method can be used to evaluate R scripts from e.g. Groovy (running already in a job). R plots a possible, too.
      Parameters:
      expression - a R expression.
